# Figures for TFX Fiscal 2014

- **S&P 500 Index (2014):** 205 (Source: documents/report.md)
- **Teleflex Incorporated (2009):** 100 (Source: documents/report.md)
- **Teleflex Incorporated (2013):** 190 (Source: documents/report.md)
- **S&P 500 Index (2010):** 132 (Source: documents/report.md, Restated Figure)

### Total Percentage Growth for the S&P 500 Index from 2010-2014

The total percentage growth for the S&P 500 Index from 2010 to 2014 is calculated as follows:

\[ \text{Percentage Growth} = \left( \frac{\text{Value in 2014} - \text{Value in 2010}}{\text{Value in 2010}} \right) \times 100 \]

\[ \text{Percentage Growth} = \left( \frac{205 - 132}{132} \right) \times 100 \approx 55.30\% \]

**Note:** The S&P 500 Index value for 2010 has been restated from 115 to 132. All downstream calculations and comparisons should use the restated figure.

- **Teleflex Incorporated (2013):** 190 (Source: documents/report.md)
- **S&P 500 Index (2010):** 132 (Source: documents/report.md, Restated Figure)

### Total Percentage Growth for the S&P 500 Index from 2010-2014

The total percentage growth for the S&P 500 Index from 2010 to 2014 is calculated as follows:

\[ \text{Percentage Growth} = \left( \frac{\text{Value in 2014} - \text{Value in 2010}}{\text{Value in 2010}} \right) \times 100 \]

\[ \text{Percentage Growth} = \left( \frac{205 - 132}{132} \right) \times 100 \approx 55.30\% \]

**Note:** The S&P 500 Index value for 2010 has been restated from 115 to 132. All downstream calculations and comparisons should use the restated figure.
